<a2ui>
surface("status-list")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Active", value: "active"}, {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}, {label: "Blocked", value: "blocked"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}], "all", "status_filter")
list = entity_list([{name: "Migrate billing service", subtitle: "Moving invoices to the new ledger API", status: "Active"}, {name: "Update onboarding copy", subtitle: "Waiting on legal review of the new terms", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Fix login timeout", subtitle: "Blocked by the identity provider outage", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Launch referral program", subtitle: "Shipped to all regions last Friday", status: "Done"}, {name: "Redesign settings page", subtitle: "Prototype in review with design", status: "Active"}, {name: "Audit access permissions", subtitle: "Scheduled to start next sprint", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Upgrade database cluster", subtitle: "Needs budget approval before scheduling", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Archive legacy reports", subtitle: "Completed and verified by the data team", status: "Done"}])
title = heading("Work items")
hint = body("Filter by status")
root = columns(2, "1.5rem", "top", [{blocks: [title, hint, filter]}, {blocks: [list]}])
</a2ui>

The catalog has no component that filters a list on its own. The segmented control is the status filter (All, Active, Pending, Blocked, Done). The list holds eight items, each with a title, a status, and a one-line detail. The filter isn't wired to the list, so choosing a status won't hide any rows yet.
